# Y8.com

> > Y8.com is a global free online gaming platform featuring HTML5, WebGL, and Flash games with personalized recommendations and creator monetization tools.

Y8.com operates as a comprehensive gaming hub offering thousands of free browser-based games across multiple genres including driving, racing, casual, and fashion games. The platform supports game developers through its studio program with revenue sharing opportunities and provides game distribution services for website embedding.

## Game Discovery & Browsing

- [Home](https://www.y8.com): Y8.com homepage: Global gaming platform with HTML5, WebGL, and Flash games
- [New Games](https://www.y8.com/new/games): Browse newest game releases on Y8.com including recent titles and updates
- [Popular Games](https://www.y8.com/popular/games): Discover most popular free online games on Y8.com with ratings
- [Game Tags & Categories](https://www.y8.com/tags): Game tags and categories directory for browsing Y8.com game collections

## User Profile & Personalization

- [Played Games](https://www.y8.com/profile/played_games): User profile section showing played games history and library
- [Liked Games](https://www.y8.com/profile/liked_games): User profile section displaying favorite and liked games collection
- [Recommended Games](https://www.y8.com/profile/recommended_games): Personalized game recommendations based on user profile and history

## Game Publishing & Monetization

- [Game Studios](https://www.y8.com/studios): Creator program for game developers to publish and monetize games
- [Revenue Share Program](https://www.y8.com/revshare): Revenue sharing program documentation for game developers and publishers
- [Games for Your Website](https://www.y8.com/games_for_your_website): Game distribution service: embed HTML5 and WebGL games on websites

## Content & Entertainment
